source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Understanding Cyber Threats (PDF 126, printed 122).

blocks.text: Cyber threats aise kaam ya programs hain jo nuqsan pohanchane ke liye computers aur networks ko nishana banate hain. In mein maloomat churana, systems kharab karna ya online services rokna shamil hai. Yeh samajhna ke khatre kaise kaam karte hain, users ko shuru ke khatre ke nishan pehchanne mein madad deta hai. Zyada tar hamlon se mehfooz browsing, antivirus software aur emails aur links mein ehtiyat se bacha ja sakta hai. Khatron ko pehchanna digital systems ki hifazat ki taraf pehla qadam hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Phishing sab se aam hamlon mein se ek hai.

blocks.prompt: Cyber threats kya karte hain, aur zyada tar hamlon se kaise bacha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh maloomat churate, systems kharab karte ya online services rokte hain. Mehfooz browsing, antivirus aur emails aur links ke saath ehtiyat se zyada tar hamle ruk jate hain.

items: Cyber threats: computers aur networks ko nuqsan pohanchane wale kaam ya programs.
Khatre pehchanna hifazat ka pehla qadam hai.
